findings: THE HOLDINGS AT THEIR GRAIN. 'An interactive timeline tracking Irish left organizations and parties from 1900 to the present.' The archive keeps every organisation of a fissile left, its rival parties included, on one record and one timeline.
THE ORIGIN NOT CARRIED. 'It was initiated by the Cedar Lounge Revolution .' (the archive's home page). The composition names the podcast's hosts and no holder of the archive.

[QUERENT] Irish Left Archive

[SYSTEM] The Irish Left Archive is a digital project and online repository dedicated to collecting, preserving, and sharing material related to left-wing politics, activism, and history in Ireland. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESUwHrOzAVhISG8tU8-6XR42Lg9WvH0Sot3e_hMBz7h7n3MXrGnedWvtn3d4x9aJ5CkNVMJMk1ayDG36HSftjP9bfjCwZIXPKvSn9zMqbk1fZLn8MG)]
Key Features of the Archive

* Digital Collection: Freely accessible documents, manifestos, pamphlets, and publications from various Irish left-wing and progressive organizations. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESUwHrOzAVhISG8tU8-6XR42Lg9WvH0Sot3e_hMBz7h7n3MXrGnedWvtn3d4x9aJ5CkNVMJMk1ayDG36HSftjP9bfjCwZIXPKvSn9zMqbk1fZLn8MG)]
* Timeline of the Irish Left: An interactive timeline tracking Irish left organizations and parties from 1900 to the present. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESUwHrOzAVhISG8tU8-6XR42Lg9WvH0Sot3e_hMBz7h7n3MXrGnedWvtn3d4x9aJ5CkNVMJMk1ayDG36HSftjP9bfjCwZIXPKvSn9zMqbk1fZLn8MG)]
* Scope & Contents: Holds over 1,200 documents, hundreds of organizations, publications, profiles, and collections covering socialism, communism, trade unionism, republicanism, and-anarchism. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESXAHrOzAV0YzierbyRCOqgpKgVdrtiwvx9cWdkpOdUWvky4UkDgpN1fRsLcVSEywi2bFFE--vQK_ma0C6Ekaq4zpzDKbq1j_-FMw4Fe1aVryBb4UqRK2wU5VOMA2-), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESUwHrOzAVhISG8tU8-6XR42Lg9WvH0Sot3e_hMBz7h7n3MXrGnedWvtn3d4x9aJ5CkNVMJMk1ayDG36HSftjP9bfjCwZIXPKvSn9zMqbk1fZLn8MG)]
* Personal Accounts: Collects first-hand observations and reminiscences from activists and participants in Irish left movements. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESUwHrOzAVhISG8tU8-6XR42Lg9WvH0Sot3e_hMBz7h7n3MXrGnedWvtn3d4x9aJ5CkNVMJMk1ayDG36HSftjP9bfjCwZIXPKvSn9zMqbk1fZLn8MG)]

The Irish Left Archive Podcast
Hosted by Ciarán Swan and Aonghus Storey, the project also produces a regular podcast featuring interviews with activists, writers, historians, and politicians discussing left-wing movements, campaigns, and political history in Ireland. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESlwEB6zswFQlgEmaAg93o3cK8J3BJ-c12O4Z4nAVMLnZujRC2m-IB0auRBKfuFGewkKJqxYPRwIPr14di3zSJko7vfEdLGb_qilfD3qMBwiwYM5BfnIsYQMAYmp5m2KMwP6_iHFtWRUiYAxl7T0Uw0LEJSQWWQmnjUFLGES7z0uUtxmbul2xTG_O_mJ3J28F4m39Gd59WDJZJ)]
You can explore the digital collection, timelines, and recent updates directly on the [Irish Left Archive Website](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESUwHrOzAVhISG8tU8-6XR42Lg9WvH0Sot3e_hMBz7h7n3MXrGnedWvtn3d4x9aJ5CkNVMJMk1ayDG36HSftjP9bfjCwZIXPKvSn9zMqbk1fZLn8MG) or listen to episodes via the [Irish Left Archive Podcast on Spotify](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESbAHrOzAVbotIvJ4T0AEf2woM8nDrZBA6MIhSXsBiHXIjdtIPZIhuz0zsb2CXvOQKhkmSEDWFTUfpIkNMBQcDTB7ev6jBpc0WQmgi3Ck9IkLH6DSleXq9waQGdOaJmj7yMYQNd6aNbYQduP_iuA).
